description: Fork of exp001 (vanilla MinimalGPT GPT-2 baseline, 23M params, b=8 -> 1.6256) with device_batch_size 8 -> 16. Pair with exp271 (b=32) to test whether the bigger-batch lever from exp266/exp267 (LUT-LM, ~0.16 bpb gain b=8->b=32) is LUT-specific or general transformer behaviour. If vanilla shows similar magnitude, the LUT-specific 'sparse per-token gradients' hypothesis weakens; if vanilla shows much smaller gains, it strengthens.
